data.credibility: Management demonstrates reliable execution by delivering on mid-single-digit value growth (4.3%) and H1 VAM-VAE commissioning. They consistently reiterate volume and margin targets, showing transparency and accountability across quarters.

lines.line: Promised mid-single-digit value growth; delivered 4.3% value growth for full year.
Promised high single-digit volume growth; on track with 9% achieved in Q1.
Promised H1 commissioning for VAM-VAE phase one; successfully delivered.
Promised 18-20% margin band; on track with 22% reported in Q1.
Promised 150,000 MT VAE capacity over 2-2.5 years; currently on track.
Promised full capacity utilization of phase one next year; status is pending.
Promised gross margin band of 41% to 43% in second half; pending.
